resources.string: Choose how Unreel handles YouTube Shorts.
YouTube Shorts
Your installed version supports Shorts protection.

With your permission, Unreel reads layout identifiers in YouTube to recognise Shorts. Depending on your mode and schedule, it can press Back and show a pause screen. Unreel keeps daily totals for time in Shorts and exits for seven days on this device. It never stores screen content or reads titles or messages. Turn it off here or in Android accessibility settings.
